text:
Potsdam’s median asking rent stands at 14.55 €/m², up 8.0 % year‑on‑year and 30.2 % over the past five years, placing the city seventh among the 37 most expensive German markets. The premium over existing rents is 85 %, with a typical 60 m² unit costing 873 € per month.

The market is tight: vacancy is only 1.3 %, listings stay on the market for 22 days and 40 % are let within a week. Rent‑burden for a two‑person household is 19.2 %, reflecting limited affordability despite modest population growth of 5.4 % over five years.

A model estimate forecasts the median asking rent at 15.35 €/m² in 12 months, ranging between 14.64 €/m² and 15.72 €/m², implying a further 5.5 % rise.
